acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
alkylation_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
alkylation_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
fragmentation_method: followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap with rapid scan rate
instrument: Peptides were separated by high pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC) using an Dionex Ultimate 3000 LC-system (Thermo Scientific) and analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364)
mass_analyzer: analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
reduction_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
reduction_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
